# Slots

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
Using slots An extension point inside a drop-in where custom UI or behavior can be added, replaced, or removed. provides the deepest level of customization for drop-in components. A slot provides a place in a drop-in container A pre-built UI module that renders drop-in functionality and manages logic, state, and data for a feature. to add your own UI components and functions. This architecture makes it easy to change the default look, layout, and behavior. Let’s learn how slots work.

## Big Picture

Section titled “Big Picture”
What is a slot?
The following functions are available to all slots:

- prependSibling: Prepends a new HTML element before the content of the slot.
- prependChild: Prepends a new HTML element to the content of the slot.
- replaceWith: Replaces the content of the slot with a new HTML element.
- appendChild: Appends a new HTML element to the content of the slot.
- appendSibling: Appends a new HTML element after the content of the slot.
- remove: Removes the slot from the DOM.
- getSlotElement: Gets a slot element.
- onChange: Listens to changes in the context of the slot.
- dictionary: Provides a JSON Object for the current locale. If the locale changes, the dictionary values change to reflect the values for the selected language.

## Best practice for dynamic slot content

Section titled “Best practice for dynamic slot content”
**Do not use context methods inside other context methods.** Context methods include appendChild(), prependChild(), replaceWith(), appendSibling(), prependSibling(), remove(), getSlotElement(), and onChange().

Instead, create and append wrapper elements on mount, then update their content inside callbacks using standard DOM methods like innerHTML:

# Styling Drop-In Components

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
Customize drop-in components using the design token system and CSS classes from the boilerplate. This guide covers the universal styling approach used across all drop-ins.

## Drop-in-specific styles

Section titled “Drop-in-specific styles”
Each drop-in has a dedicated styles page with practical customization examples. See the individual drop-in documentation:

- [Cart styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/styles/)
- [Checkout styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/checkout/styles/)
- [Order styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/order/styles/)
- [Payment Services styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/payment-services/styles/)
- [Personalization styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/personalization/styles/)
- [Product Details styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/product-details/styles/)
- [Product Discovery styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/product-discovery/styles/)
- [Recommendations styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/recommendations/styles/)
- [User Account styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/user-account/styles/)
- [User Auth styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/user-auth/styles/)
- [Wishlist styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/wishlist/styles/)

## Where to add custom styles

Section titled “Where to add custom styles”
Add your custom CSS in the appropriate location based on the scope of your changes:

### Global styles and design token overrides

Section titled “Global styles and design token overrides”
- Edit [styles/styles.css](https://github.com/hlxsites/aem-boilerplate-commerce/blob/main/styles/styles.css) to override design tokens or add site-wide styles
- These styles load immediately and affect all drop-ins

### Block-specific styles

Section titled “Block-specific styles”
- Add styles to blocks/{block-name}/{block-name}.css
- For example: [blocks/product-details/product-details.css](https://github.com/hlxsites/aem-boilerplate-commerce/blob/main/blocks/product-details/product-details.css)
- These styles load only when the block is used
- See all [available blocks](https://github.com/hlxsites/aem-boilerplate-commerce/tree/main/blocks) in the boilerplate

### Deferred global styles

Section titled “Deferred global styles”
- Add to [styles/lazy-styles.css](https://github.com/hlxsites/aem-boilerplate-commerce/blob/main/styles/lazy-styles.css) for non-critical styles that can load after page render
- Improves initial page load performance

## Design tokens

Section titled “Design tokens”
The drop-in components use CSS custom properties (design tokens) defined in the styles/styles.css file from the boilerplate. These tokens ensure consistent styling across all drop-ins and make global theme changes easy to apply.

### Override design tokens

Section titled “Override design tokens”
Change the appearance of all drop-ins by overriding design tokens in your custom CSS:

## Finding CSS classes

Section titled “Finding CSS classes”
Use the browser DevTools to find specific class names for your customizations:

Inspect the UI of any drop-in component using your browser developer tools:

Find CSS classes to override.
- **Inspect the element** you want to customize (right-click the element and select “Inspect” from the menu).
- **Identify the CSS class(es)** for the element. We use [BEM naming](https://getbem.com/naming/) , which makes components and their elements easy to identify. For example, .pdp-product__title indicates the title element of the product component.
- **Copy the CSS class** to your CSS file to override existing rules or add new rules. If the class uses design tokens (like var(--spacing-small)), override the token value instead of removing it. This keeps your customizations consistent with the design system.

## Responsive breakpoints

Section titled “Responsive breakpoints”
Drop-in components use these breakpoints:

- **Mobile**: up to 767px
- **Tablet**: 768px - 1023px
- **Desktop**: 1024px and up

Use a mobile-first approach when you add responsive styles:

```

## Advanced customization

Section titled “Advanced customization”
### Inspect CSS variables in use

Section titled “Inspect CSS variables in use”
Use the browser DevTools to discover which CSS variables (design tokens) a component is using:

- **Right-click on any element** and select “Inspect”
- **In the Styles panel**, look for properties using var() syntax
- **Click the variable name** (e.g., var(--spacing-medium)) to see its computed value
- **In the Computed tab**, filter by “spacing”, “color”, etc. to see all applied tokens

#### Example: Inspecting a button might show

Section titled “Example: Inspecting a button might show”
```
1
padding: var(--spacing-small);    
/* Resolves to: 16px */
2
background: var(--color-brand-500); 
/* Resolves to: #454545 */
```

### How tokens flow through components

Section titled “How tokens flow through components”
Design tokens control the visual appearance of components by mapping to specific CSS properties. Understanding this flow helps you predict what changes when you override a token.

#### The flow:

Section titled “The flow:”
- A design token is defined in the boilerplate: --spacing-small: 16px
- A component uses it in a CSS property: gap: var(--spacing-small);
- The browser resolves it to the actual value: gap: 16px
- The visual effect appears: 16px of spacing between grid items

#### Real-world example: Cart grid spacing

Section titled “Real-world example: Cart grid spacing”
The grid component for the Cart drop-in uses --spacing-small to control the gap between product images:

,

fr
);

}
```

The gap property controls spacing between grid items in both directions.
When you override --spacing-small, you directly change how tightly or loosely the product images are packed together. A smaller value (8px) creates a denser grid, while a larger value (24px) creates more breathing room.

#### Common token-to-property mappings

Section titled “Common token-to-property mappings”
- --spacing-* tokens → gap, padding, margin properties → Controls whitespace
- --color-* tokens → background, color, border-color properties → Controls visual identity
- --shape-border-radius-* tokens → border-radius property → Controls corner roundness
- --type-* tokens → font, font-size, line-height properties → Controls typography

# Cart overview | Adobe Commerce Storefront

**Fonte original:** https://experienceleague.adobe.com/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart

**Coletado em (UTC):** 2026-07-22T14:26:45.544864+00:00

---

# Cart overview

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The cart drop-in component provides a variety of fully editable controls to help you view, update, and merge the products in your cart and mini-cart, including image thumbnails, pricing, descriptions, quantities, estimated shipping and taxes, order summary, merging guest and authenticated carts, and more.

## Supported Commerce features

Section titled “Supported Commerce features”
The following table provides an overview of the Adobe Commerce features that the cart supports:

| Feature | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Adobe Experience Platform Audiences | Roadmap |
| All product types | Supported |
| Apply coupons | Supported |
| Apply gift cards | Supported |
| Apply gift options | Supported |
| Cart API extensibility | Supported |
| Cart layout templates | Supported |
| Cart rules | Supported |
| Cart with 100+ products | Supported |
| Commerce segments | Supported |
| Customer cart | Supported |
| Edit product configuration in cart | Supported |
| Estimate tax/shipping | Supported |
| Guest cart | Supported |
| Low product stock alert | Supported |
| Mini-cart | Supported |
| No-code UI configurations | Supported |
| Out of stock/insufficient quantity products | Supported |
| Product line discounts (catalog rule, special price, tier price) | Supported |
| Save to wishlist | Supported |
| Slots for extensibility | Supported |
| Taxes: Fixed | Roadmap |
| Taxes: Sales, VAT | Supported |
| Undo remove product from cart | Supported |

## Section topics

Section titled “Section topics”
The topics in this section will help you understand how to customize and use the cart effectively within your storefront.

### Quick Start

Section titled “Quick Start”
Provides quick reference information and a getting started guide for the Cart drop-in. This topic covers package details, import paths, and basic usage examples to help you integrate shopping cart functionality into your site. Visit the [Cart quick start](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/quick-start/) page to get started.

### Styles

Section titled “Styles”
Describes how to customize the appearance of the cart using CSS. We provide guidelines and examples for applying styles to various components within the drop-in. This customization allows brands to align the drop-in component’s look and feel with their overall design aesthetic, enhancing brand consistency across the platform. Visit the [cart styles](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/styles/) page to learn more.

### Containers

Section titled “Containers”
Describes the structural elements of the cart, specifically focusing on how containers manage and display content. It includes information on configuration options and how to leverage these settings to customize the user experience. Understanding containers is essential for developers looking to optimize the layout and styling of the cart. Visit the cart containers page to learn more.

### Slots

Section titled “Slots”
Slots allow developers to customize the appearance of the cart by adding or modifying content within specific sections of the drop-in component. Visit the [cart slots](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/slots/) page to learn more.

### Functions

Section titled “Functions”
Describes the API functions available in the Cart drop-in. These functions allow developers to retrieve and display detailed cart information dynamically. Visit the [Cart Functions](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/functions/) page to learn more.

The **Cart** drop-in provides pre-built container components for integrating into your storefront.

Version: 3.3.0
## What are Containers?

Section titled “What are Containers?”
Containers are pre-built UI components that combine functionality, state management, and presentation. They provide a complete solution for specific features and can be customized through props, slots, and CSS.

## Available Containers

Section titled “Available Containers”
| Container | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [CartSummaryGrid](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/cart-summary-grid/) | Learn about the CartSummaryGrid container. |
| [CartSummaryList](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/cart-summary-list/) | Learn about the CartSummaryList container. |
| [CartSummaryTable](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/cart-summary-table/) | Learn about the CartSummaryTable container. |
| [Coupons](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/coupons/) | Learn about the Coupons container. |
| [EmptyCart](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/empty-cart/) | Learn about the EmptyCart container. |
| [EstimateShipping](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/estimate-shipping/) | Learn about the EstimateShipping container. |
| [GiftCards](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/gift-cards/) | Learn about the GiftCards container. |
| [GiftOptions](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/gift-options/) | Learn about the GiftOptions container. |
| [MiniCart](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/mini-cart/) | Displays a summary of the shopper’s shopping cart. |
| [OrderSummary](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/order-summary/) | Learn about the OrderSummary container. |
| [OrderSummaryLine](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/cart/containers/order-summary-line/) | Learn about the OrderSummaryLine container. |

Tip

Each container is designed to work independently but can be composed together to create comprehensive user experiences.

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });

      try {

    }

        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';

          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });

The CartSummaryGrid container manages and displays the contents of the shopping cart in a grid layout. Its state is managed by the CartModel interface, which contains the cart’s initial data and is passed down to any child components.

CartSummaryGrid container
## Configurations

Section titled “Configurations”
The CartSummaryGrid container provides the following configuration options:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | CartModel | Yes | Child elements to be rendered inside the container. |
| initialData | string | Yes | Initial cart data to preload the component. Defaults to null. |
| routeProduct | function | No | Callback function that returns a product. |
| routeEmptyCartCTA | function | No | Callback function that returns an empty cart. |

# CartSummaryList container

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The CartSummaryList container displays a summary of the items in the shopping cart by rendering a list of CartItem components. Each CartItem represents an individual item in the cart.

CartSummaryList container
## Configurations

Section titled “Configurations”
The CartSummaryList container provides the following configuration options:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | CartModel | Yes | Child elements to be rendered inside the container. |
| routeProduct | function | No | Callback function that returns a product. |
| routeEmptyCartCTA | function | No | Callback function that returns an empty cart. |
| initialData | string | Yes | Initial cart data to preload the component. Defaults to null. |
| hideHeading | boolean | No | Whether to hide the heading of the cart. |
| hideFooter | boolean | No | Whether to hide the footer of the cart. |
| routeCart | function | No | Callback function that navigates to the cart. |
| onItemUpdate | function | No | Callback function that updates the item. |
| onItemRemove | function | No | Callback function that removes the item. |
| maxItems | number | No | Maximum number of items to display. |
| slots | function | No | Allows passing a container or custom component. |
| attributesToHide | string[] | No | Attributes to hide. |
| enableRemoveItem | boolean | No | Enable remove item. |
| enableUpdateItemQuantity | boolean | { removeOnZero?: boolean } | No | Enables the quantity stepper. Pass { removeOnZero: true } to also remove the item when the quantity reaches 0; defaults to false. |
| onItemsErrorsChange | function | No | Callback function that changes the items errors. |
| accordion | boolean | No | Toggle accordion view. |
| variant | primary | secondary | No | Cart variant. |
| isLoading | boolean | No | Toggle loading state. |
| showMaxItems | boolean | No | Toggle show max items. |
| showDiscount | boolean | No | Toggle show discount. |
| showSavings | boolean | No | Toggle show savings. |
| quantityType | stepper | dropdown | No | Display quantity changes as a stepper or in a dropdown menu. |
| dropdownOptions | string[] | No | An array of items to display in a dropdown menu. |
| undo | boolean | No | Enables the undo banner to restore recently removed items to the cart. |
| includeOutOfStockItems | boolean | No | Display out-of-stock and insufficient-quantity items in the main cart item list alongside in-stock items. Default: false. |
| confirmBeforeDelete | boolean | No | Enables the confirmation banner when an item is removed from the cart. When set to true, clicking the remove button shows an inline confirmation banner instead of immediately deleting the item. |

## Supported slots

Section titled “Supported slots”
The CartSummaryList container supports the following slots:

- Heading
- EmptyCart
- Footer
- Thumbnail
- ProductAttributes
- CartSummaryFooter
- CartItem
- UndoBanner
- ConfirmDeleteBanner
- ItemTitle
- ItemPrice
- ItemQuantity
- ItemTotal
- ItemSku
- ItemRemoveAction

## Example configuration

Section titled “Example configuration”
The following example demonstrates how to render the CartSummaryList container with the routeProduct and routeEmptyCartCTA callbacks:

# CartSummaryTable container

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The CartSummaryTable container displays a summary of the items in the shopping cart by rendering a table of cart items. Each row represents an individual item in the cart, with columns for the item details, price, quantity, subtotal, and actions.

CartSummaryTable container
## Features

Section titled “Features”
The CartSummaryTable container includes the following features:

- Automatic loading state with skeleton UI
- Support for out-of-stock items with visual indicators
- Quantity update functionality with error handling
- Item removal capability
- Tax price display (including/excluding)
- Product image display with lazy loading
- Configurable product routing
- Customizable slots for all major components
- Support for product configurations
- Warning and alert message display
- Discount and savings display

## Configurations

Section titled “Configurations”
The CartSummaryTable container provides the following configuration options:

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| initialData | CartModel | null | No | Initial data for the cart. Defaults to null. |
| className | string | No | Optional CSS class name for custom styling. |
| routeProduct | function | No | Function for getting the product page route. |
| allowQuantityUpdates | boolean | No | Whether to allow quantity updates. Defaults to true. |
| allowRemoveItems | boolean | No | Whether to allow removing items. Defaults to true. |
| onQuantityUpdate | function | No | Callback function when quantity is updated. |
| onItemRemove | function | No | Callback function when an item is removed. |
| routeEmptyCartCTA | function | No | Function to generate the URL for the empty cart call-to-action button. |
| undo | boolean | No | Enables the undo banner to restore recently removed items to the cart. |

## Supported slots

Section titled “Supported slots”
The CartSummaryTable container supports the following slots for customization:

- Item : Customize the item cell content Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number] }
- Price : Customize the price cell content Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number] }
- Quantity : Customize the quantity cell content Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number], isUpdating: boolean, quantityInputValue: number, handleInputChange: (e: Event) => void, itemUpdateErrors: Map<string, string> }
- Subtotal : Customize the subtotal cell content Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number] }
- Thumbnail : Customize the thumbnail image on an item Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number], defaultImageProps: ImageProps, index: number }
- ProductTitle : Customize the product title on an item Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number] }
- Sku : Customize the product SKU on an item Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number] }
- Configurations : Customize the product configurations on an item Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number] }
- ItemAlert : Customize the product alert on an item Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number] }
- ItemWarning : Customize the product warning on an item Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number] }
- Actions : Customize the actions on an item Context: { item: CartModel['items'][number], itemsUpdating: Map<string, { isUpdating: boolean, updatedValue: number }>, setItemUpdating: (uid: string, state: boolean) => void, setItemUpdateError: (uid: string, error: string) => void }

## Example configuration

Section titled “Example configuration”
The following example demonstrates how to render the CartSummaryTable container with the some of the configuration options and slots:

# Coupons container

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The Coupons container manages the application of coupons to the shopping cart. It provides a text box for users to enter coupon codes. The container uses the applyCouponsToCart function to apply the coupon to the cart.

Coupons container
## Configurations

Section titled “Configurations”
The Coupons container has no public configuration options. Render it without any props inside an OrderSummary slot.

## Example configuration

Section titled “Example configuration”
The following example demonstrates how to render the Coupons container as part of the OrderSummary slot:
