# Product Details Data & Events

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The **Product Details** drop-in uses the [event bus](/developer/commerce/storefront/sdk/reference/events) to emit and listen to events for communication between drop-ins and external integrations.

Version: 3.2.0
## Events reference

Section titled “Events reference”
| Event | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [pdp/valid](#pdpvalid-emits) | Emits | Emitted when validation state changes. |
| [pdp/setValues](#pdpsetvalues-listens) | Listens | Fired by PDP (pdp) when values are set programmatically. |
| [pdp/data](#pdpdata-emits-and-listens) | Emits and listens | Triggered when data is available or changes. |
| [pdp/values](#pdpvalues-emits-and-listens) | Emits and listens | Triggered when form or configuration values change. |

## Event details

Section titled “Event details”
The following sections provide detailed information about each event, including its direction, event payload, and usage examples.

# Product Details Functions | Adobe Commerce Storefront

**Fonte original:** https://experienceleague.adobe.com/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/product-details/functions

# Product Details Functions

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The Product Details drop-in provides API functions that enable you to programmatically control behavior, fetch data, and integrate with Adobe Commerce backend services.

Version: 3.2.0
| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [fetchProductData](#fetchproductdata) | Fetches product data for a given SKU. |
| [getFetchedProductData](#getfetchedproductdata) | Returns previously fetched product data from cache. |
| [getProductConfigurationValues](#getproductconfigurationvalues) | Returns the current product configuration values. |
| [getProductData](#getproductdata) | Returns the product data for a given product SKU. |
| [getProductsData](#getproductsdata) | Fetches multiple products by SKUs with optional per-product option configuration. |
| [getRefinedProduct](#getrefinedproduct) | Returns refined product data with specific options selected. |
| [isProductConfigurationValid](#isproductconfigurationvalid) | Checks if the current product configuration is valid. |
| [setProductConfigurationValid](#setproductconfigurationvalid) | Sets a callback to be called when product configuration validity changes. |
| [setProductConfigurationValues](#setproductconfigurationvalues) | Sets a callback to be called when product configuration values change. |

## fetchProductData

Section titled “fetchProductData”
The fetchProductData function fetches product data for a given SKU. It can fetch either simple product data or refined product data with selected options.

## getProductData

Section titled “getProductData”
The getProductData function returns the product data for a given product SKU. It fetches data from Adobe Commerce and optionally preselects the first available option. The function calls the [products](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/products/queries/products/) query.

```
1
const
 
getProductData
 
=
 
async
 (
2
  
sku
:
 
string
,
3
  
options
?:
 { 
preselectFirstOption
?:
 
boolean
; 
optionsUIDs
?:
 
string
[]; },
4
  
raw
?:
 
boolean
5
): 
Promise
<
ProductModel 
|
 
null
>
```

| Parameter | Type | Req? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sku | string | Yes | The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the product to fetch. |
| preselectFirstOption | boolean | No | Whether to automatically preselect the first available option for configurable products. |
| optionsUIDs | string[] | No | An array of option UIDs to preselect for the product. |
| raw | boolean | No | Whether to return raw GraphQL data without transformation. |

### Events

Section titled “Events”
Does not emit any drop-in events.

### Returns

Section titled “Returns”
Returns [ProductModel](#productmodel) or null.

## getProductsData

Section titled “getProductsData”
The getProductsData function fetches multiple products by their SKUs in a single request. Each item can include optional configuration such as selected option UIDs and a flag to pre-select the first available option. Useful for bulk product data retrieval, such as in Quick Order or product list pages.

```
1
const
 
getProductsData
 
=
 
async
 (
2
  
items
:
 
ProductDataItem
[],
3
  
raw
?:
 
boolean
4
): 
Promise
<
ProductModel[] 
|
 
null
>
```

| Parameter | Type | Req? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| items | ProductDataItem[] | Yes | An array of product request objects. Each object must include a sku and optionally optionsUIDs (array of selected option UIDs) and preselectFirstOption (boolean to auto-select the first available option for each swatch). |
| raw | boolean | No | When true, returns the raw GraphQL response without transformation. Defaults to false. |

### Events

Section titled “Events”
Does not emit any drop-in events.

### Returns

Section titled “Returns”
Returns an array of [ProductModel](#productmodel) objects or null when no products are found or the input is empty.

## getRefinedProduct

Section titled “getRefinedProduct”
The getRefinedProduct function returns refined product data with specific options selected. This is used for configurable products where options have been chosen. The function calls the [refineProduct](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/catalog-service/queries/refine-product) query.

For configurable products, the returned [ProductModel](#productmodel) always keeps the parent product’s name and sku. When refinement resolves to a simple variant (SimpleProductView), the model also includes variantSku and variantName for that variant so you can display or forward the child SKU and title (for example from the [ProductHeader](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/product-details/containers/product-header/) container).

```

:
 
string
[],
4

?:
 
string
[],

?:
 
boolean
6
): 
Promise
<
ProductModel 
|
 
null
>
```

| Parameter | Type | Req? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sku | string | Yes | The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the product to fetch. |
| optionUIDs | string[] | Yes | An array of option UIDs representing the selected variant. |
| anchorOptions | string[] | No | Anchor options for the product selection. |
| raw | boolean | No | Whether to return raw GraphQL data without transformation. |

### Events

Section titled “Events”
Does not emit any drop-in events.

### Returns

Section titled “Returns”
Returns [ProductModel](#productmodel) or null.

# Product Details initialization

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The **Product Details initializer** configures how product information is displayed and managed, including images, descriptions, pricing, and options. Use initialization to customize product data models and enhance product presentation.

Version: 3.2.0
## Configuration options

Section titled “Configuration options”
The following table describes the configuration options available for the **Product Details** initializer:

| Parameter | Type | Req? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| langDefinitions | [LangDefinitions](#langdefinitions) | No | Language definitions for internationalization (i18n). Override dictionary keys for localization or branding. |
| models | [Record<string, any>](#models) | No | Custom data models for type transformations. Extend or modify default models with custom fields and transformers. |
| scope | string | No | Defines the store view scope for product data retrieval. Used in multi-store setups to fetch store-specific product information. |
| defaultLocale | string | No | Sets the default locale for product content when no specific locale is detected. |
| globalLocale | string | No | Overrides locale detection and forces all product content to use this specific locale regardless of user settings. |
| sku | string | No | Pre-loads a specific product SKU on initialization. Useful for server-side rendering or direct product page access. |
| acdl | boolean | No | Configuration for Adobe Client Data Layer (ACDL) integration to track product view events and user interactions for analytics. |
| anchors | string[] | No | Controls hash navigation behavior for product page sections (e.g., #reviews, #specifications). Enables deep linking to specific content areas. |
| persistURLParams | boolean | No | Determines which URL query parameters should persist when navigating between product variants. Useful for tracking campaigns or referral sources. |
| preselectFirstOption | boolean | No | When `true`, automatically selects the first available option for each configurable attribute. Streamlines selection for products with default variants. |
| optionsUIDs | string[] | No | Pre-selects specific product options by their unique identifiers. Useful for direct links to configured product variants (e.g., specific `size/color` combinations). |

## Default configuration

Section titled “Default configuration”
The initializer runs with these defaults when no configuration is provided:

## Language definitions

Section titled “Language definitions”
Override dictionary keys for localization or branding. The langDefinitions object maps locale keys to custom strings that override default text for the drop-in.

```
1
import
 { initializers } 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/initializer.js'
;
2
import
 { initialize } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-pdp'
;
3

4
const
 
customStrings
 
=
 {
5
  
'AddToCart'
: 
'Add to Bag'
,
6
  
'Checkout'
: 
'Complete Purchase'
,
7
  
'Price'
: 
'Cost'
,
8
};
9

10
const
 
langDefinitions
 
=
 {
11
  
default: customStrings,
12
};
13

14
await
 initializers.
mountImmediately
(initialize, { langDefinitions });
```

Tip

For complete dictionary customization including all available keys and multi-language support, see the [Product Details Dictionary](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/product-details/dictionary/) page.

## Customizing data models

Section titled “Customizing data models”
Extend or transform data models by providing custom transformer functions. Use the models option to add custom fields or modify existing data structures returned from the backend.

### Model properties

Section titled “Model properties”
Each model in the models configuration object supports the following properties:

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| initialData | any | Provides initial data for the model before backend data is fetched. |
| transformer | (data?: ProductModel) => ProductModel | Transforms product data returned from GraphQL. Use this to add custom fields or modify existing data structures. |
| transform | (data?: ProductModel) => ProductModel | **Deprecated.** Use transformer instead. |
| fallbackData | (parentProduct: any, simpleProduct: ProductModel) => ProductModel | Provides fallback data when a simple product variant is selected from a configurable parent product. |

The following example shows how to customize a model for the **Product Details** drop-in:

```
1
import
 { initializers } 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/initializer.js'
;
2
import
 { initialize } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-pdp'
;
3

4
const
 
models
 
=
 {
5
  
ProductModel: {
6
    
transformer
: (
data
) 
=>
 ({
7
      
...
data,
8
      
customField: data?.custom_field,
9
      
promotionBadge: data?.promotion?.label,
10
      
displayPrice: data?.price?.value 
?
 
`${
data
.
price
.
value
}`
 
:
 
'N/A'
,
11
    
}),
12
  
},
13
};
14

15
await
 initializers.
mountImmediately
(initialize, { models });
```

## Drop-in configuration

Section titled “Drop-in configuration”
The **Product Details initializer** configures how product information is displayed and managed, including images, descriptions, pricing, and options. Use initialization to customize product data models and enhance product presentation.

```
1
import
 { initializers } 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/initializer.js'
;
2
import
 { initialize } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-pdp'
;
3

4
await
 initializers.
mountImmediately
(initialize, {
5
  
scope: 
'value'
,
6
  
langDefinitions: {},
7
  
defaultLocale: 
'value'
,
8
  
globalLocale: 
'value'
,
9
  
sku: 
'value'
,
10
  
acdl: 
true
,
11
  
anchors: 
'value'
,
12
  
persistURLParams: 
true
,
13
  
preselectFirstOption: 
true
,
14
  
optionsUIDs: 
'abc123'
,
15
  
models: {},
16
});
```

Note

Refer to the [Configuration options](#configuration-options) table for detailed descriptions of each option.

## Configuration types

Section titled “Configuration types”
The following TypeScript definitions show the structure of each configuration object:

### langDefinitions

Section titled “langDefinitions”
Maps locale identifiers to dictionaries of key-value pairs. The default locale is used as the fallback when no specific locale matches. Each dictionary key corresponds to a text string used in the drop-in UI.

```
1
langDefinitions
?:
 {
2
  
[locale: string]: {
3
    
[key: string]: string;
4
  
};
5
};
```

### models

Section titled “models”
Maps model names to objects that configure how product data is transformed. Each model can provide an initial data state, a transformer function to modify GraphQL responses, and a fallback for configurable product variants.

```

?:
 {
2
  
[name: string]: {
3
    
initialData: any;
4
    
/** 
@deprecated
 Use "transformer" instead */
5
    
transform
?:
 (
data
?:
 
ProductModel
) 
=>
 ProductModel;
6
    
transformer
?:
 (
data
?:
 
ProductModel
) 
=>
 ProductModel;
7
    
fallbackData
?:
 (
parentProduct
:
 
any
, 
simpleProduct
:
 
ProductModel
) 
=>
 ProductModel;
8
  
};
9
};
```

# Product Details Quick Start

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The Product Details drop-in provides a comprehensive product display page with image galleries, pricing, options, swatches, and add-to-cart functionality for all product types.

Version: 3.2.0
## Quick example

Section titled “Quick example”
The Product Details drop-in is included in the [Commerce boilerplate](https://github.com/hlxsites/aem-boilerplate-commerce) . This example shows the basic pattern:

## Quick reference

Section titled “Quick reference”
**Import paths:**

- Initializer: import '../../scripts/initializers/pdp.js'
- Containers: import ContainerName from '@dropins/storefront-pdp/containers/ContainerName.js'
- Provider: import { render } from '@dropins/storefront-pdp/render.js'

**Package:** @dropins/storefront-pdp

**Version:** 3.2.0 (verify compatibility with your Commerce instance)

**Example container:** ProductAttributes

# Product Details Slots

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The Product Details drop-in exposes slots on each composed container so you can customize specific UI sections. Use slots to replace or extend those container components.

See the [containers overview](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/product-details/containers/) for the official deprecation wording. The summary table includes a deprecated ProductDetails row so you can map legacy slot names during migration. Use the sections below for [ProductAttributes](#productattributes-slots), [ProductGallery](#productgallery-slots), [ProductOptions](#productoptions-slots), and [ProductDetails (deprecated) slots](#productdetails-deprecated-slots). For default properties available to all slots, see [Extending drop-in components](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/all/extending/). For Add to Cart, Add to Wishlist, and similar buttons, read [Add to Cart and Add to Wishlist](#add-to-cart-and-add-to-wishlist) first, because that pattern is not covered by the slots in the table below.

Version: 3.2.0
| Container | Slots | Deprecated |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [ProductAttributes](#productattributes-slots) | Attributes | No |
| [ProductGallery](#productgallery-slots) | CarouselThumbnail, CarouselMainImage | No |
| [ProductOptions](#productoptions-slots) | Swatches, SwatchImage | No |
| [ProductDetails container (deprecated)](#productdetails-deprecated-slots) | Title, SKU, RegularPrice, SpecialPrice, Options, Quantity, Actions, ShortDescription, Description, Attributes, Breadcrumbs, GalleryContent, InfoContent, Content | Yes |

## Add to Cart and Add to Wishlist

Section titled “Add to Cart and Add to Wishlist”
The slot topics for ProductAttributes, ProductGallery, and ProductOptions describe the supported Commerce boilerplate pattern. The [ProductDetails (deprecated) slots](#productdetails-deprecated-slots) section documents the legacy monolithic container only. None of these slot topics is the extension point for placing a secondary button directly under Add to Cart in the Commerce boilerplate, and you do not need to fork @dropins/storefront-pdp to get that layout. For the supported pattern, see [Commerce storefront layouts](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/all/layouts/#add-an-element-to-the-layout-and-reference-it) (the product-details__buttons markup) and the bullets below for wiring Add to Cart and Add to Wishlist.

In the Commerce boilerplate, those controls live in your product-details block: you define empty mount elements in the HTML fragment (next to or below the quantity area), then your block script renders into them. The [Commerce storefront layouts](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/all/layouts/) topic shows a product-details__buttons row with separate targets for Add to Cart and Add to Wishlist so you can stack or arrange them with ordinary CSS.

Use that composition pattern together with the Product Details event bus:

- Add to Cart — Your block owns the button and wires it to cart logic and pdp/data / pdp/valid (see [Notify Me CTA](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/product-details/tutorials/notify-me-cta/) for the same mount pattern when stock changes the label).
- Add to Wishlist — Initialize the Wishlist drop-in, then render [WishlistToggle](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/wishlist/containers/wishlist-toggle/) into a second mount point (for example, the wishlist div next to the cart div in the layout). Subscribe to pdp/data so the product you pass into WishlistToggle updates when the shopper changes configurable options.

For wishlist setup and imports, start at [Wishlist quick start](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/wishlist/quick-start/).

## ProductAttributes slots

Section titled “ProductAttributes slots”
The slots for the ProductAttributes container allow you to customize its appearance and behavior.

## ProductDetails (deprecated) slots

Section titled “ProductDetails (deprecated) slots”
Deprecated

The monolithic ProductDetails container is deprecated. It is not used in the Commerce boilerplate. Do not use it for new work. Compose the smaller containers from the [containers overview](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/product-details/containers/) instead. This section is for legacy code only. For migration context, see [Product details page architectural evolution](/developer/commerce/storefront/boilerplate/updates/#product-details-page-architectural-evolution).

The slots for the ProductDetails container (deprecated) allow you to customize its appearance and behavior.

# Product Details styles

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
Customize the Product Details drop-in using CSS classes and design tokens. This page covers the Product Details-specific container classes and customization examples. For comprehensive information about design tokens, responsive breakpoints, and styling best practices, see [Styling Drop-In Components](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/all/styling/).

Version: 3.2.0
## Customization example

Section titled “Customization example”
Add this to the CSS file of the specific [commerce block](https://github.com/hlxsites/aem-boilerplate-commerce/blob/main/blocks/) where you’re using the Product Details drop-in.

For a complete list of available design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, and more), see the [Design tokens reference](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/all/styling/#design-tokens-reference).
