# User Auth initialization

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The **User Auth initializer** configures authentication and authorization features including login, registration, password management, and session handling. Use initialization to customize authentication flows and user data models.

Version: 4.0.0
## Configuration options

Section titled “Configuration options”
The following table describes the configuration options available for the **User Auth** initializer:

| Parameter | Type | Req? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| langDefinitions | [LangDefinitions](#langdefinitions) | No | Language definitions for internationalization (i18n). Override dictionary keys for localization or branding. |
| models | [Record<string, any>](#models) | No | Custom data models for type transformations. Extend or modify default models with custom fields and transformers. |
| authHeaderConfig | [authHeaderConfig](#authheaderconfig) | No | Configures authentication header format for API requests including custom header names and token prefix format (e.g., ‘Bearer’, ‘Token’). |
| customerPermissionRoles | boolean | No |  |
| adobeCommerceOptimizer | boolean | No |  |

## Default configuration

Section titled “Default configuration”
The initializer runs with these defaults when no configuration is provided:

## Language definitions

Section titled “Language definitions”
Override dictionary keys for localization or branding. The langDefinitions object maps locale keys to custom strings that override default text for the drop-in.

```
1
import
 { initializers } 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/initializer.js'
;
2
import
 { initialize } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-auth'
;
3

4
const
 
customStrings
 
=
 {
5
  
'AddToCart'
: 
'Add to Bag'
,
6
  
'Checkout'
: 
'Complete Purchase'
,
7
  
'Price'
: 
'Cost'
,
8
};
9

10
const
 
langDefinitions
 
=
 {
11
  
default: customStrings,
12
};
13

14
await
 initializers.
mountImmediately
(initialize, { langDefinitions });
```

Tip

For complete dictionary customization including all available keys and multi-language support, see the [User Auth Dictionary](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/user-auth/dictionary/) page.

## Customizing data models

Section titled “Customizing data models”
Extend or transform data models by providing custom transformer functions. Use the models option to add custom fields or modify existing data structures returned from the backend.

### Available models

Section titled “Available models”
The following models can be customized through the models configuration option:

| Model | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [CustomerModel](#customermodel) | Transforms customer authentication data including profile information, addresses, and account settings. Use this to add custom fields or modify user data structures. |

The following example shows how to customize the CustomerModel model for the **User Auth** drop-in:

```
1
import
 { initializers } 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/initializer.js'
;
2
import
 { initialize } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-auth'
;
3

4
const
 
models
 
=
 {
5
  
CustomerModel: {
6
    
transformer
: (
data
) 
=>
 ({
7
      
// Add custom fields from backend data
8
      
customField: data?.custom_field,
9
      
promotionBadge: data?.promotion?.label,
10
      
// Transform existing fields
11
      
displayPrice: data?.price?.value 
?
 
`${
data
.
price
.
value
}`
 
:
 
'N/A'
,
12
    
}),
13
  
},
14
};
15

16
await
 initializers.
mountImmediately
(initialize, { models });
```

## Drop-in configuration

Section titled “Drop-in configuration”
The **User Auth initializer** configures authentication and authorization features including login, registration, password management, and session handling. Use initialization to customize authentication flows and user data models.

```
1
import
 { initializers } 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/initializer.js'
;
2
import
 { initialize } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-auth'
;
3

4
await
 initializers.
mountImmediately
(initialize, {
5
  
langDefinitions: {},
6
  
authHeaderConfig: {},
7
  
customerPermissionRoles: 
true
,
8
  
adobeCommerceOptimizer: 
true
,
9
  
models: {},
10
});
```

Note

Refer to the [Configuration options](#configuration-options) table for detailed descriptions of each option.

## Configuration types

Section titled “Configuration types”
The following TypeScript definitions show the structure of each configuration object:

### authHeaderConfig

Section titled “authHeaderConfig”
Configures authentication header format for API requests including custom header names and token prefix format (e.g., ‘Bearer’, ‘Token’).

```
1
authHeaderConfig
?:
 {
2
    
header: string;
3
    
tokenPrefix: string;
4
  
}
```

### langDefinitions

Section titled “langDefinitions”
Maps locale identifiers to dictionaries of key-value pairs. The default locale is used as the fallback when no specific locale matches. Each dictionary key corresponds to a text string used in the drop-in UI.

```
1
langDefinitions
?:
 {
2
  
[locale: string]: {
3
    
[key: string]: string;
4
  
};
5
};
```

### models

Section titled “models”
Maps model names to transformer functions. Each transformer receives data from GraphQL and returns a modified or extended version. Use the Model<T> type from @dropins/tools to create type-safe transformers.

```
1
models
?:
 {
2
  
[modelName: string]: Model
<
any
>
;
3
};
```

# User Auth Quick Start

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The User Auth drop-in handles customer authentication flows including sign-in, account creation, password reset, and email confirmation with support for both guest and registered users.

## Quick reference

Section titled “Quick reference”
**Import paths:**

- Initializer: import '../../scripts/initializers/auth.js'
- Containers: import ContainerName from '@dropins/storefront-auth/containers/ContainerName.js'
- Provider: import { render } from '@dropins/storefront-auth/render.js'

**Package:** @dropins/storefront-auth

**Version:** 4.0.0 (verify compatibility with your Commerce instance)

**Example container:** AuthCombine

**Fonte original:** https://experienceleague.adobe.com/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/user-auth/recaptcha

# reCAPTCHA integration

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The reCAPTCHA module enables reCAPTCHA protection, which is natively supported by Adobe Commerce. It supports both **reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible** and **reCAPTCHA Enterprise**. The module automatically detects the configured type in Commerce Admin and loads the appropriate script and API.

The module also provides an API that allows merchants to integrate reCAPTCHA protection into custom form implementations.

[Google reCAPTCHA](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/commerce-admin/systems/security/captcha/security-google-recaptcha) in the *Admin Systems Guide* describes how to configure Adobe Commerce.

Using the Commerce Boilerplate?

The reCAPTCHA module is implemented in the [Commerce Boilerplate](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/developer/commerce/storefront/get-started/boilerplate-project/) within the /scripts/initializers/index.js file. The boilerplate calls setEndpoint, enableLogger, and setConfig during app initialization. If your form is part of a drop-in component, reCAPTCHA is already configured. You only need to call initReCaptcha and verifyReCaptcha in your form.

Mixed reCAPTCHA types

All forms must use the same reCAPTCHA type, either all v3 or all Enterprise. If the Commerce Admin configuration has some forms configured with v3 and others with Enterprise, the module will log a warning and **disable reCAPTCHA entirely**. Update your Commerce Admin configuration so all forms use the same type.

## Integration

Section titled “Integration”
To integrate the reCAPTCHA module, follow these steps. **The calling order matters** because each step depends on completing the previous step.

- Set the endpoint and fetch configuration. Call setEndpoint (if needed) and setConfig during app initialization. setConfig fetches the reCAPTCHA configuration from Commerce via the recaptchaFormConfig GraphQL endpoint, then stores it in sessionStorage . 1 import * as reCAPTCHA from '@dropins/tools/recaptcha.js' ; 2 3 reCAPTCHA. setEndpoint ( 'https://www.example.com/graphql' ); 4 await reCAPTCHA. setConfig ();
- Initialize reCAPTCHA on pages with protected forms. Call initReCaptcha to load the Google reCAPTCHA script and render badges. Do not call this at the top level of the application. Call it only on pages that have forms protected by reCAPTCHA . 1 await reCAPTCHA. initReCaptcha ();
- Get a token on form submission. Call verifyReCaptcha when the user submits the form. Pass the returned token in the X-ReCaptcha header. 1 const token = await reCAPTCHA. verifyReCaptcha (); 2 if (token) { 3 fetchGraphQlApi. setFetchGraphQlHeader ( 'X-ReCaptcha' , token); 4 } 5 // Proceed with the GraphQL mutation
- Commerce validates the token. If validation fails, Commerce returns an error.

### Flow for forms covered by Adobe Commerce natively

Section titled “Flow for forms covered by Adobe Commerce natively”
Use the following workflow for standard Adobe Commerce integrations (login, registration, contact, and so on):

- Call verifyReCaptcha to retrieve the reCAPTCHA token.
- Set the token in the X-ReCaptcha header.
- Send the GraphQL mutation. Commerce validates the token server-side and returns an error if validation fails.

### Flow for custom form integrations

Section titled “Flow for custom form integrations”
For custom forms not natively covered by Commerce, you need to add an inline badge container and call setConfig with your badge ID. setConfig is safe to call even if the global initializer has already run. The fetch uses force-cache and the badge entry is additive.

```
1
import
 
*
 
as
 reCAPTCHA 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/recaptcha.js'
;
2
import
 { CORE_FETCH_GRAPHQL } 
from
 
'../../scripts/commerce.js'
;
3

4
// Create a badge container in your form
5
const
 
badgeId
 
=
 
'my-custom-form-badge'
;
6
const
 
badge
 
=
 document.
createElement
(
'div'
);
7
badge.id 
=
 badgeId;
8
form.
appendChild
(badge);
9

10
// Configure and initialize
11
reCAPTCHA.
setEndpoint
(
CORE_FETCH_GRAPHQL
);
12
await
 reCAPTCHA.
setConfig
([{ badgeId }]);
13
await
 reCAPTCHA.
initReCaptcha
(
0
); 
// 0ms delay if already in an idle callback
14

15
// On submit
16
const
 
token
 
=
 
await
 reCAPTCHA.
verifyReCaptcha
();
```

Tip

The configList parameter in setConfig does **not** override or filter the backend configuration. It only adds extra DOM containers for inline badge rendering. The backend determines which forms are enabled and which reCAPTCHA type (v3 or Enterprise) is used.

## reCAPTCHA API

Section titled “reCAPTCHA API”
The reCAPTCHA package exposes the following APIs:

- setEndpoint
- setConfig
- initReCaptcha
- verifyReCaptcha
- enableLogger

### setEndpoint

Section titled “setEndpoint”
Sets the GraphQL endpoint that the module uses to fetch the configuration. This is optional if reCAPTCHA uses the same endpoint used by the rest of the application. It inherits from the fetch-graphql package.

**Must be called before setConfig** if the endpoint differs from the default.

#### Usage

Section titled “Usage”
```
1
import
 
*
 
as
 reCAPTCHA 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/recaptcha.js'
;
2

3
reCAPTCHA.
setEndpoint
(
'https://www.example.com/graphql'
);
```

### setConfig

Section titled “setConfig”
Fetches the reCAPTCHA configuration from Commerce via the [recaptchaFormConfig](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql/schema/store/queries/recaptcha-form-config/) GraphQL endpoint, then stores the normalized result in sessionStorage. The module queries all known form types in a single request and determines the reCAPTCHA type (v3 or Enterprise) automatically.

**Must be called before initReCaptcha and verifyReCaptcha .**

#### Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”
| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| configList | PropsFormTypes[] | Optional. Array of { badgeId: string } objects specifying additional DOM element IDs where inline reCAPTCHA badges should be rendered. |

#### Usage

Section titled “Usage”
The following example calls the setConfig function without parameters for standard Commerce forms:

```
1
import
 
*
 
as
 reCAPTCHA 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/recaptcha.js'
;
2

3
await
 reCAPTCHA.
setConfig
();
```

Now pass a configList to add inline badge containers for custom forms:

```
1
await
 reCAPTCHA.
setConfig
([{ badgeId: 
'my-form-badge'
 }]);
```

The configList entries are **additive**. This example shows how to add extra badge containers to the forms returned by the backend. They do not filter, restrict, or override which forms are enabled.

### initReCaptcha

Section titled “initReCaptcha”
This function loads the Google reCAPTCHA script and initializes badges. The module automatically selects the correct script based on the configured reCAPTCHA type:

- **v3**: https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js
- **Enterprise**: https://www.google.com/recaptcha/enterprise.js

**This function must be called after calling setConfig .** Call initReCaptcha on pages with protected forms, not globally. Otherwise, the reCAPTCHA scripts load on every page.

#### Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| lazyLoadTimeout | number | 3000 | Delay in milliseconds before loading the script. Use 0 when calling from an idle callback or when the form is already in the viewport. |

#### Usage

Section titled “Usage”
```
1
import
 
*
 
as
 reCAPTCHA 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/recaptcha.js'
;
2

3
// Default: 3-second lazy load delay
4
await
 reCAPTCHA.
initReCaptcha
();
5

6
// No delay (e.g., inside requestIdleCallback)
7
await
 reCAPTCHA.
initReCaptcha
(
0
);
```

### verifyReCaptcha

Section titled “verifyReCaptcha”
Retrieves a reCAPTCHA token via the Google API. The Enterprise type uses grecaptcha.enterprise.execute(). The v3 type uses grecaptcha.execute(). If reCAPTCHA is disabled in the Commerce Admin, the function returns undefined, allowing forms to proceed without protection.

**Must be called after setConfig and initReCaptcha .**

#### Usage

Section titled “Usage”
For forms supported by native Adobe Commerce functionality, pass the token as an X-ReCaptcha header:

```
1
import
 
*
 
as
 reCAPTCHA 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/recaptcha.js'
;
2

3
const
 
token
 
=
 
await
 reCAPTCHA.
verifyReCaptcha
();
4
if
 (token) {
5
  
fetchGraphQlApi.
setFetchGraphQlHeader
(
'X-ReCaptcha'
, token);
6
}
7
// Proceed with mutation — Commerce validates the token server-side
```

For custom forms, validate the token on the server side or client side according to your implementation.

### enableLogger

Section titled “enableLogger”
Enables [ReCaptcha]-prefixed debug-logging in the browser console. The logs trace the full lifecycle for development and debugging:

- Config fetch and normalization (which forms are enabled, which type is detected)
- Forms skipped due to missing website_key
- Mixed-type warnings
- Script loading URL
- Badge rendering per form
- Token requests and results

#### Usage

Section titled “Usage”
```
1
import
 
*
 
as
 reCAPTCHA 
from
 
'@dropins/tools/recaptcha.js'
;
2

3
reCAPTCHA.
enableLogger
(
true
);
```

## Limitations

Section titled “Limitations”
- **Mixed reCAPTCHA types are not supported.** If you configure the Commerce Admin with both v3 and Enterprise types, the module disables reCAPTCHA entirely and logs a warning. All forms must use the same type.
- **Per-form type support is planned** for a future release. This will allow the v3 type on some forms and the Enterprise type on others, simultaneously.
- **Forms with empty website_key** are skipped. If a form is enabled in Commerce Admin but has no website key configured, it is treated as disabled and a debug log is emitted.

# User Auth Slots

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The User Auth drop-in exposes slots for customizing specific UI sections. Use slots to replace or extend container components. Slot render functions receive a context object (for example, DefaultSlotContext, ResetPasswordSlotContext) with properties such as isLoading, isSuccessful, and where relevant passwordError. For default properties available to all slots, see [Extending drop-in components](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/all/extending/).

Version: 4.0.0
Slot usage best practices

Do not use context methods inside other context methods (for example, appendChild() inside onChange()). See [Slots best practices](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/all/slots/#best-practice-for-dynamic-slot-content) for details and examples.

| Container | Slots |
| --- | --- |
| [SignIn](#signin-slots) | Title, Form, Buttons, SuccessNotification |
| [SignUp](#signup-slots) | Title, Form, Buttons, SuccessNotification, PrivacyPolicyConsent, RemoteShoppingAssistanceConsent |
| [ResetPassword](#resetpassword-slots) | Title, Form, Buttons |
| [SuccessNotification](#successnotification-slots) | SuccessNotificationActions |
| [UpdatePassword](#updatepassword-slots) | Title, Form, Buttons, SuccessNotification |

### Title slot

Section titled “Title slot”
The Title slot allows you to customize the form title/header.

### Form slot

Section titled “Form slot”
The Form slot allows you to customize the main form area (email + password fields and layout).

### Buttons slot

Section titled “Buttons slot”
The Buttons slot allows you to customize the button row (for example, forgot password, sign up link, submit).

#### Example

Section titled “Example”

as
 provider } 
from

;
2
import
 { SignIn } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-auth/containers/SignIn.js'
;
3

4
await
 provider.
render
(SignIn, {
5
  
slots: {
6
    
Title
: (
ctx
) 
=>
 {
7
      
const
 
element
 
=
 document.
createElement
(
'p'
);
8
      
element.innerText 
=
 
'Welcome. Please login to shop with your account.'
;
9
      
ctx.
appendChild
(element);
10
    
},
11
    
Form
: (
ctx
) 
=>
 {
12
      
const
 
wrapper
 
=
 document.
createElement
(
'div'
);
13
      
wrapper.innerHTML 
=
 
'<p class="custom-intro">Enter your credentials below.</p>'
;
14
      
ctx.
prependSibling
(wrapper);
15
    
},
16
    
Buttons
: (
ctx
) 
=>
 {
17
      
const
 
element
 
=
 document.
createElement
(
'div'
);
18
      
element.className 
=
 
'signin-buttons'
;
19
      
ctx.
appendChild
(element);
20
    
}
21
  
}
22
})(block);

### RemoteShoppingAssistanceConsent slot

Section titled “RemoteShoppingAssistanceConsent slot”
The RemoteShoppingAssistanceConsent slot lets you customize the remote shopping assistance consent checkbox shown in the SignUp form. This slot belongs to the seller-assisted buying feature and renders only when seller-assisted buying is enabled at the store level. When the feature is disabled, the slot does not render. For the end-to-end flow and Admin setup, see [Seller-assisted buying](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/user-account/containers/seller-assisted-buying/).

#### Example

Section titled “Example”
```
1
import
 { render 
as
 provider } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-auth/render.js'
;
2
import
 { SignUp } 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-auth/containers/SignUp.js'
;
3

4
await
 provider.
render
(SignUp, {
5
  
slots: {
6
    
RemoteShoppingAssistanceConsent
: (
ctx
) 
=>
 {
7
      
const
 
wrapper
 
=
 document.
createElement
(
'div'
);
8
      
wrapper.className 
=
 
'custom-consent'
;
9

10
      
const
 
input
 
=
 document.
createElement
(
'input'
);
11
      
input.type 
=
 
'checkbox'
;
12
      
input.name 
=
 
'allowRemoteShoppingAssistance'
;
13
      
input.value 
=
 
'true'
;
14

15
      
const
 
label
 
=
 document.
createElement
(
'label'
);
16
      
label.
append
(input, 
' I agree to remote shopping assistance'
);
17

18
      
wrapper.
appendChild
(label);
19
      
ctx.
appendChild
(wrapper);
20
    
},
21
  
}
22
})(block);
```

Tip

The form reads the consent value by looking for an input named allowRemoteShoppingAssistance with value="true". If your custom implementation omits that name or value, the consent flag is silently dropped from the create-account mutation. Make sure your custom implementation also meets any consent and privacy requirements for your region.

# User Auth styles

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();

# Wishlist overview

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The wishlist drop-in component provides both guests and registered customers with a mechanism to store products they are interested in purchasing later.

The wishlist component is fully customizable and can be integrated into your storefront to enhance the shopping experience.

## Use cases

Section titled “Use cases”
The wishlist drop-in component offers a variety of fully customizable controls to highlight your products (according to your brand’s aesthetics) and create interactive experiences. Use cases include:

- **Save for later**: Users can save products they find interesting to a dedicated location for quick access when they are ready to make a purchase.
- **Synchronization**: When a guest user creates an account or logs in, their wishlist items automatically sync across all devices where they are signed in.

## Supported Commerce features

Section titled “Supported Commerce features”
The following table provides an overview of the Adobe Commerce features that the wishlist drop-in component supports:

| Feature | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Wishlist a product for customers | Supported |
| Move a product from wishlist to cart | Supported |
| Move a product from cart to wishlist | Supported |

The **Wishlist** drop-in provides pre-built container components for integrating into your storefront.

Version: 3.3.0
## What are Containers?

Section titled “What are Containers?”
Containers are pre-built UI components that combine functionality, state management, and presentation. They provide a complete solution for specific features and can be customized through props, slots, and CSS.

## Available Containers

Section titled “Available Containers”
| Container | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Wishlist](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/wishlist/containers/wishlist/) | Learn about the wishlist container. |
| [WishlistAlert](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/wishlist/containers/wishlist-alert/) | Learn about the WishlistAlert container. |
| [WishlistItem](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/wishlist/containers/wishlist-item/) | Learn about the WishlistItem container. |
| [WishlistToggle](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/wishlist/containers/wishlist-toggle/) | Learn about the WishlistToggle container. |

Tip

Each container is designed to work independently but can be composed together to create comprehensive user experiences.
