# Overview

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();

# Event Bus

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The Event Bus enables different parts of your application to communicate and stay synchronized through message passing. It supports event-driven architecture for drop-ins, allowing containers to react to changes from other containers and communicate data changes to the storefront.

Tip

**New to event-driven architecture?** Learn about the [event system architecture and patterns](/developer/commerce/storefront/dropins/all/events/) including the publish-subscribe pattern, event declarations, and best practices before diving into the API.

## Core Methods

Section titled “Core Methods”
### Subscribe to Events

Section titled “Subscribe to Events”
Subscribe to events and receive notifications when they occur.

```
1
const
 
eventListener
 
=
 events.
on
(
'<event>'
, (
payload
) 
=>
 {
2
  
// Handle the event payload
3
  
console.
log
(
'Event received:'
, payload);
4
});
5

6
// Stop listening to the event
7
eventListener.
off
();
```

**Example:**

```
1
// Listen for cart updates
2
const
 
cartListener
 
=
 events.
on
(
'cart/data'
, (
cartData
) 
=>
 {
3
  
if
 (cartData) {
4
    
console.
log
(
`Cart has ${
cartData
.
totalQuantity
} items`
);
5
    
updateCartUI
(cartData);
6
  
} 
else
 {
7
    
console.
log
(
'Cart is empty'
);
8
    
showEmptyCart
();
9
  
}
10
});
11

12
// Later, when you want to stop listening
13
cartListener.
off
();
```

### Emit Events

Section titled “Emit Events”
Broadcast events to all listeners across your application.

```
1
events.
emit
(
'<event>'
, payload);
```

**Examples:**

```
1
// Emit cart data
2
const
 
cartData
 
=
 {
3
  
id: 
'cart-123'
,
4
  
totalQuantity: 
2
,
5
  
items: [
6
    
{ uid: 
'item-1'
, quantity: 
1
, sku: 
'PROD-001'
, name: 
'Product Name'
 }
7
  
]
8
};
9

10
events.
emit
(
'cart/data'
, cartData);
```

### Get Last Event Payload

Section titled “Get Last Event Payload”
Retrieve the most recent payload for a specific event.

```
1
const
 
lastPayload
 
=
 events.
lastPayload
(
'<event>'
);
```

**Example:**

```
1
// Get the current cart state without waiting for an event
2
const
 
currentCart
 
=
 events.
lastPayload
(
'cart/data'
);
3

4
if
 (currentCart) {
5
  
console.
log
(
'Current cart total:'
, currentCart.totalQuantity);
6
}
```

### Enable Debug Logging

Section titled “Enable Debug Logging”
Enable console logging to debug event flow.

```
1
// Enable logging to see all events in console
2
events.
enableLogger
(
true
);
```

## Advanced Features

Section titled “Advanced Features”
### Eager Loading

Section titled “Eager Loading”
When subscribing to events, you can execute the event handler immediately with the last known payload. This is useful for getting the current state without waiting for the next event.

```
1
// Handler will execute immediately if there's a previous payload
2
const
 
listener
 
=
 events.
on
(
'cart/data'
, (
cartData
) 
=>
 {
3
  
console.
log
(
'Cart data received:'
, cartData);
4
}, { eager: 
true
 });
```

**Use cases:**

- Initialize UI components with current state
- Avoid waiting for the first event emission
- Ensure components have the latest data on mount

### Event Scoping

Section titled “Event Scoping”
Create namespaced events to avoid conflicts between different parts of your application.

```
1
// Subscribe to a scoped event
2
const
 
scopedListener
 
=
 events.
on
(
'data/update'
, (
data
) 
=>
 {
3
  
console.
log
(
'Scoped data received:'
, data);
4
}, { scope: 
'feature-a'
 });
5

6
// Emit a scoped event
7
events.
emit
(
'data/update'
, payload, { scope: 
'feature-a'
 });
8

9
// Get last payload for a scoped event
10
const
 
lastScopedData
 
=
 events.
lastPayload
(
'data/update'
, { scope: 
'feature-a'
 });
```

**Scoped event names:** When using scopes, the actual event name becomes scope/event. For example:

- 'feature-a/data/update' instead of 'data/update'
- 'module-b/user/action' instead of 'user/action'

**Use cases:**

- Separate different features or modules
- Different contexts within the same application
- Component-specific event handling

### Combining Options

Section titled “Combining Options”
Use both eager loading and scoping together for powerful event handling.

```
1
// Subscribe to a scoped event with eager loading
2
const
 
listener
 
=
 events.
on
(
'locale'
, (
locale
) 
=>
 {
3
  
console.
log
(
'Current locale:'
, locale);
4
}, {
5
  
eager: 
true
,
6
  
scope: 
'user-preferences'
7
});
```

## Event-Driven Drop-ins

Section titled “Event-Driven Drop-ins”
The Event Bus enables drop-ins to be truly event-driven, allowing for loose coupling between components and seamless communication across the application.

### Container-to-Container Communication

Section titled “Container-to-Container Communication”
Containers can react to changes from other Containers, enabling complex interactions without direct dependencies.

```
1
// Product Container: Emits when a product is added to cart
2
function
 
ProductContainer
() {
3
  
const
 
handleAddToCart
 
=
 (
product
) 
=>
 {
4
    
// Add to cart logic...
5

6
    
// Notify other containers about the cart change
7
    
events.
emit
(
'cart/data'
, updatedCartData);
8
  
};
9

10
  
return
 (
11
    
<
button onClick
=
{() => 
handleAddToCart
(
product
)}
>
12
      
Add to 
Cart
13
    
</
button
>
14
  
);
15
}
16

17
// Cart Container: Reacts to cart changes from any source
18
function
 
CartContainer
() {
19
  
useEffect
(() 
=>
 {
20
    
const
 
cartListener
 
=
 events.
on
(
'cart/data'
, (
cartData
) 
=>
 {
21
      
updateCartDisplay
(cartData);
22
      
updateCartBadge
(cartData.totalQuantity);
23
    
}, { eager: 
true
 });
24

25
    
return
 () 
=>
 cartListener.
off
();
26
  
}, []);
27

28
  
return
 <
CartDisplay
 />;
29
}
30

31
// Mini Cart Container: Also reacts to the same cart changes
32
function
 
MiniCartContainer
() {
33
  
useEffect
(() 
=>
 {
34
    
const
 
cartListener
 
=
 events.
on
(
'cart/data'
, (
cartData
) 
=>
 {
35
      
updateMiniCart
(cartData);
36
    
}, { eager: 
true
 });
37

38
    
return
 () 
=>
 cartListener.
off
();
39
  
}, []);
40

41
  
return
 <
MiniCart
 />;
42
}
```

### Storefront Communication

Section titled “Storefront Communication”
Drop-ins can communicate data changes to the storefront, enabling seamless integration with the host application.

```
1
// Authentication Container: Notifies storefront of login/logout
2
function
 
AuthContainer
() {
3
  
const
 
handleLogin
 
=
 (
userData
) 
=>
 {
4
    
// Login logic...
5

6
    
// Notify storefront of authentication change
7
    
events.
emit
(
'authenticated'
, 
true
);
8
  
};
9

10
  
const
 
handleLogout
 
=
 () 
=>
 {
11
    
// Logout logic...
12

13
    
// Notify storefront of authentication change
14
    
events.
emit
(
'authenticated'
, 
false
);
15
  
};
16

17
  
return
 <
AuthForm
 
onLogin
={
handleLogin
} 
onLogout
={
handleLogout
} />;
18
}
19

20
// Storefront can listen for authentication changes
21
// This would be in the host application
22
const
 
authListener
 
=
 events.
on
(
'authenticated'
, (
isAuthenticated
) 
=>
 {
23
  
if
 (isAuthenticated) {

showUserMenu
();

enableCheckout
();

else

hideUserMenu
();
28
    
disableCheckout
();
29
  
}
30
}, { eager: 
true
 });
```

## Best Practices

Section titled “Best Practices”
- **Always unsubscribe** from events when components unmount to prevent memory leaks
- **Use scopes** to organize events by feature or component
- **Enable eager loading** when you need immediate access to current state
- **Use descriptive event names** that clearly indicate what data they contain
- **Handle null/undefined payloads** gracefully in your event handlers
- **Enable logging during development** to debug event flow
- **Keep event payloads lightweight** to avoid performance issues
- **Document your event contracts** so other developers know what to expect

# GraphQL Extensibility API

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The GraphQL Extensibility API allows developers to extend existing GraphQL operations used by a Drop-in to meet additional data requirements without increasing code complexity or negatively impacting performance. This API provides a flexible and efficient way to customize GraphQL Fragments by integrating build-time modifications into the storefront’s development pipeline.

## Extend your Drop-in GraphQL Fragments

Section titled “Extend your Drop-in GraphQL Fragments”
To enable GraphQL Fragments to be extensible in your Drop-in, follow these steps:

### Define Your Fragments

Section titled “Define Your Fragments”
Create the content for the fragments you are exporting.

## Extend the Data module

Section titled “Extend the Data module”
Now that we have made our fragments extensible, we must extend the data model used in our Drop-ins.

### Define Typing to the Initializer API

Section titled “Define Typing to the Initializer API”

## Using the GraphQL Extensibility Feature in Your Storefront

Section titled “Using the GraphQL Extensibility Feature in Your Storefront”
By extending the GraphQL Fragments and Models of drop-ins, you can leverage the drop-in’s existing GraphQL operations and add extra fields needed to meet your specific business requirements. This approach enhances the user experience while maintaining code simplicity and performance efficiency since all modifications are integrated into the storefront’s development build-time pipeline.

## Extend Drop-in’s Fragments and Models

Section titled “Extend Drop-in’s Fragments and Models”
Follow these steps to extend the GraphQL Fragment and Model in your Drop-in:

### Extend the GraphQL Fragment

Section titled “Extend the GraphQL Fragment”
Use the overrideGQLOperations function to extend the existing GraphQL Fragment, allowing you to add fields to the fragment as needed.

The overrideGQLOperations functions accept an array of configuration objects where you must specify:

#### npm: string

Section titled “npm: string”
The node module name of the drop-in. i.e. “@dropins/my-dropin”.

#### operations: string[]

Section titled “operations: string[]”
An array of string or template literal with operations.

- Only one definition can be provided in the operation.
- These must match the operation name as provided by the drop-in. i.e. MY_FRAGMENT.
- The operations must be valid GraphQL operations, such as Fragment. i.e. fragment MY_FRAGMENT on FragmentInterface { ... }.
- In the case of a Fragment, the fragment name must match the same interface as the drop-in. i.e. FragmentInterface.
- If an existing field that has variables is used: If not variables are provided, the existing variables will be used. i.e. favorites(page: 1) { ... } . If new variables are provided, the new variable will be added. i.e. favorites(page: 1, offset: 5) { ... } . If the existing variables are changed, the new variables will be used. i.e. favorites(page: 2) { ... } .

```
1
import
 overrideGQLOperations 
from
 
'@dropins/build-tools/gql-extend.js'
;
2

3
overrideGQLOperations
([
4
  
{
5
    
npm: 
'@dropins/my-dropin'
,
6
    
operations: [
`
7
      
fragment MY_FRAGMENT on FragmentInterface {
8
        
age
9

10
        
favorites {
11
          
quantity
12
        
}
13
      
}
14
    
`
],
15
  
},
16
]);
```

### Extend the Data Model

Section titled “Extend the Data Model”
Next, update the data models to include the new fields added to the fragment, ensuring that the additional data is correctly processed and available for use in the drop-in. i.e., Slots, Event Bus, etc.

```
1
import
 
*
 
as
 api 
from
 
'@dropins/storefront-cart/api.js'
;
2

3
initializers.
register
(api.initialize, {
4
  
models: {
5
    
MyModel: {
6
      
transformer
: (
data
) 
=>
 ({
7
        
age: data?.age,
8
        
favorites: data.favorites.
map
((
favorite
) 
=>
 ({
9
          
quantity: favorite.quantity,
10
        
})),
11
      
}),
12
    
},
13
  
},
14
});
```

# Initializer

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();

## setImageParamKeys(params)

Section titled “setImageParamKeys(params)”
The setImageParamKeys method is part of the initializers module in the @dropins/tools package. It allows you to set image parameters globally for all drop-in components that use the [Image](/developer/commerce/storefront/sdk/components/image/) component. CDN-based image optimization services, such as Fastly and Cloudflare, rely on these parameters to optimize images.

### Default behavior

Section titled “Default behavior”
Since Fastly is the default CDN for Adobe Commerce on Cloud, drop-in components add the following Fastly-style parameters to all image URLs by default:

- width
- height
- auto
- quality
- crop
- fit

Example:

```
1
/media/catalog/product/adobestoredata/ADB150.jpg?auto=webp&quality=80&crop=false&fit=cover&width=960&height=1191`
```

Technical details about CDN-based image optimization differ depending on your backend Adobe Commerce solution:

- PaaS only Fastly is the default CDN-based image optimization service for Adobe Commerce on Cloud projects. Fastly-style parameters are used by default unless overridden via setImageParamKeys .
- SaaS only Cloudflare is the default CDN-based image optimization service for Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service and Adobe Commerce Optimizer projects. Fastly-style parameters are used but are proxied through a Cloudflare Worker to transform the parameters to Cloudflare-style parameters. Overriding the default parameters using setImageParamKeys may interfere with the proxy transformation and lead to unexpected results.

Override defaults

If necessary, you can override these parameters with the setImageParamKeys method. For example, if you are using a CDN provider that requires different parameters or URL patterns.

### Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”
- params - { [key: string]: string | ((data: any) => [string, string]) } An object of key-value pairs to map image parameters to their respective keys in the URL. The value can be a string or a function that takes the parameter value as an argument and returns a tuple of the new key and transformed value.

### Functionality

Section titled “Functionality”
- If a parameter key is provided via setImageParamKeys, it is used in generating image URLs instead of the default Fastly parameters.
- If a parameter key is not provided via setImageParamKeys, it is omitted from the generated image URLs.
- If a mapped key is a function and it is not specified as a parameter in the Image component, it is called with null. It should return a tuple of the key and value.
- If a mapping callback is provided, the callback is called with the parameter value (if it exists) and should return a tuple of the new key and transformed value.
- If a mapping callback returns null, the parameter is omitted from the generated image URLs.

### Usage

Section titled “Usage”
Call the setImageParamKeys() function before the mountImmediately() function in the application layer.

```
1
// Set global image parameters
2
initializers.
setImageParamKeys
```

## setGlobalLocale(locale)

Section titled “setGlobalLocale(locale)”
The setGlobalLocale() method is part of the initializers module in the @dropins/tools package. It allows you to set a global locale for all drop-ins that use locale-sensitive components like the Price component.

### Default behavior

Section titled “Default behavior”
By default, locale-sensitive components use the browser’s locale or fallback to ‘en-US’ if no global locale is set. Locale-sensitive components follow this fallback hierarchy:

- Component-specific locale prop (highest priority)
- Global locale set via setGlobalLocale()
- Browser’s locale (navigator.language)
- Default fallback locale ('en-US') (lowest priority)

This ensures that your storefront always displays properly formatted content, even when specific locales are not configured.

### Parameters

Section titled “Parameters”
- locale - string - The locale string (e.g., ‘en-US’, ‘es-MX’, ‘fr-FR’, ‘de-DE’).

### Functionality

Section titled “Functionality”
- If a global locale is set via setGlobalLocale(), it will be used by components that support locale configuration.
- Component-specific locale props will take precedence over the global locale.
- If no global locale is set, components will fall back to the browser’s locale or a default locale.

### Usage

Section titled “Usage”
Call the setGlobalLocale() function before the mountImmediately() function in the application layer.

```
1
// Set global locale for consistent formatting across all drop-ins
2
initializers.
setGlobalLocale
(
'fr-FR'
);
3

4
// Register and Mount Initializers immediately
5
initializers.
mountImmediately
(pkg.initialize, {
6
  
// other configurations...
7
});
```

#### Basic Example

Section titled “Basic Example”
When a drop-in uses the Price component without specifying a locale prop:

```
1
<
Price
2
  
amount
=
{
100
}
3
  
currency
=
"EUR"
4
/>
```

It will render with the global locale (fr-FR) formatting:

```
1
<
span
 
class
=
"dropin-price dropin-price--default dropin-price--small dropin-price--bold"
>
2
  
100,00 €
3
</
span
>
```

#### Override Example

Section titled “Override Example”
If the same component is used with a specific locale prop, that will take precedence over the global setting:

```
1
<
Price
2
  
amount
=
{
100
}
3
  
currency
=
"EUR"
4
  
locale
=
"en-US"
5
/>
```

It will render with the specified locale (en-US) formatting:

```
1
<
span
 
class
=
"dropin-price dropin-price--default dropin-price--small dropin-price--bold"
>
2
  
€100.00
3
</
span
>
```

# Links

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
## Adding Links using the route pattern

Section titled “Adding Links using the route pattern”
Whenever possible, avoid placing onClick handlers directly on anchor elements (<a>) in drop-in components, such as product or category pages, as this results in accessibility issues and broken browser behavior. Problems include:

- Right-click > Open in New Tab results in blank pages.
- Middle-click (open in background tab) won’t work as expected.
- Keyboard navigation and screen readers may not trigger the link correctly.

Instead, follow the route pattern to provide composable and accessible navigation.

## How it works

Section titled “How it works”
Components accept a routeX function as a prop. The function receives a data model (a product, for example) and returns a URL. Internally, it’s used like this:

This lets developers customize routing logic per storefront while preserving link semantics.

## Example — Component-Side

Section titled “Example — Component-Side”
In your component (a PLP item, for example):

The routeProduct prop must be optional and default to a # or an non-functional element like a div if not provided.

# reCAPTCHA Integration

(function () {
    var KEY = 'sl-recent-searches';
    var MAX = 8;
    var MAX_TERM_LENGTH = 150;

    function load() {
      try {
        var raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '[]');
        // Validate: must be an array of strings within the length cap.
        if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
        return raw.filter(function (s) {
          return typeof s === 'string' && s.length > 0 && s.length <= MAX_TERM_LENGTH;
        });
      } catch (e) { return []; }
    }

    function save(term) {
      term = term.trim();
      if (term.length < 2 || term.length > MAX_TERM_LENGTH) return;
      var list = load().filter(function (s) { return s !== term; });
      list.unshift(term);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, MAX)));
      } catch (e) { /* QuotaExceededError or SecurityError — silently skip */ }
    }

    // onClear is passed in from setupRecentSearches so the "Clear all" button
    // can update the shared `panel` reference and show the empty state in-session.
    function buildPanel(inputEl, onClear) {
      var searches = load();
      var panel = document.createElement('div');
      panel.className = 'sl-rs';
      panel.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Recent searches');

      var header = document.createElement('div');
      header.className = 'sl-rs__header';

      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = 'Recent searches';
      header.appendChild(label);

      if (searches.length) {
        var clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
        clearBtn.className = 'sl-rs__clear';
        clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear all';
        clearBtn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (onClear) onClear();
        });
        header.appendChild(clearBtn);
      }

      panel.appendChild(header);

      if (searches.length) {
        var chips = document.createElement('div');
        chips.className = 'sl-rs__chips';
        searches.forEach(function (term) {
          var btn = document.createElement('button');
          btn.className = 'sl-rs__chip';
          btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
          btn.textContent = term;
          btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            inputEl.value = term;
            inputEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            inputEl.focus();
            panel.style.display = 'none';
          });
          chips.appendChild(btn);
        });
        panel.appendChild(chips);
      } else {
        var empty = document.createElement('p');
        empty.className = 'sl-rs__empty';
        empty.textContent = 'Your recent searches will appear here.';
        panel.appendChild(empty);
      }

      return panel;
    }

    // AbortController for the current dialog session. Calling .abort() removes
    // all session listeners in one call, preventing accumulation across opens.
    var sessionAbort = null;

    function setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl) {
      // Append to .dialog-frame, not .pagefind-ui, so Pagefind's DOM
      // re-renders (triggered by the clear button) can't remove our panel.
      var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
      // Guard: skip if frame is missing or the panel is already showing.
      if (!frame || frame.querySelector('.sl-rs')) return;

      // Cancel any leftover listeners from a previous session before attaching
      // new ones. Without this, each dialog open stacks an extra copy of every
      // listener onto the same persistent inputEl and dialog nodes.
      if (sessionAbort) sessionAbort.abort();
      sessionAbort = new AbortController();
      var signal = sessionAbort.signal;

      // Shared panel reference. refreshPanel keeps it current so that
      // syncVisibility, onClear, and the keydown handler all target the live node.
      var panel;

      // Builds a fresh panel, replaces the old one in the DOM, and updates `panel`.
      function refreshPanel(hidden) {
        var next = buildPanel(inputEl, onClear);
        if (hidden) next.style.display = 'none';
        var old = frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
        if (old) old.replaceWith(next);
        else frame.appendChild(next);
        panel = next;
      }

      // Called by the "Clear all" button. Wipes storage, rebuilds to empty state,
      // then immediately syncs visibility so the panel shows/hides correctly
      // based on the current input value without waiting for the next input event.
      function onClear() {
        localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
        refreshPanel(false);
        syncVisibility();
      }

      // Reference panel directly — avoids a DOM query on every keystroke.
      function syncVisibility() {
        panel.style.display = inputEl.value.trim() ? 'none' : '';
      }

      refreshPanel(false); // Initial render.

      // Native input event (typing).
      inputEl.addEventListener('input', syncVisibility, { signal: signal });

      // Pagefind's X button clears the input programmatically without firing
      // a native input event, so we listen for its click separately.
      var pfClear = pagefindEl.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-clear');
      if (pfClear) {
        pfClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
          setTimeout(syncVisibility, 0);
        }, { signal: signal });
      }

      inputEl.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
          // Rebuild so the saved term appears as a chip. Hidden because the
          // input still has text; syncVisibility will show it when cleared.
          refreshPanel(true);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });

      dialog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('.pagefind-ui__result-link') && inputEl.value.trim()) {
          save(inputEl.value);
        }
      }, { signal: signal });
    }

    function attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog) {
      var inputEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
      var pagefindEl = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');

      if (inputEl && pagefindEl) {
        setupRecentSearches(dialog, inputEl, pagefindEl);
        return;
      }

      // PagefindUI hasn't mounted yet — observe for it with a bounded timeout.
      var inner;
      var innerTimer;
      inner = new MutationObserver(function () {
        // Dialog was closed before Pagefind mounted — bail out cleanly.
        if (!dialog.open) { clearTimeout(innerTimer); inner.disconnect(); return; }
        var inp = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui__search-input');
        var pf = searchDiv.querySelector('.pagefind-ui');
        if (inp && pf) {
          clearTimeout(innerTimer); // Cancel the safety timeout — no longer needed.
          inner.disconnect();
          setupRecentSearches(dialog, inp, pf);
        }
      });
      inner.observe(searchDiv, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      innerTimer = setTimeout(function () { inner.disconnect(); }, 5000);
    }

    function init() {
      // Remove this IIFE's own listener immediately on every call. If setup
      // cannot complete yet, we re-add it below so the next navigation retries.
      // This prevents no-op listeners from accumulating on document: each content
      // swap (View Transitions) re-executes is:inline, creating a new IIFE and a
      // new `init`. Without this pattern, every navigation would leave a stale
      // no-op listener on document even after the dialog guard fires.
      document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', init);

      // #starlight__search is a <div> INSIDE the <dialog>, not a wrapper around it.
      var searchDiv = document.getElementById('starlight__search');
      if (!searchDiv) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      var dialog = searchDiv.closest('dialog');
      if (!dialog) {
        document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init); // Retry on next nav.
        return;
      }

      // Guard against duplicate observer creation across View Transition content
      // swaps. A data attribute on the persistent dialog element survives DOM swaps
      // and prevents a second outer MutationObserver from being attached.
      // No re-add here — setup is permanent once the dialog is found.
      if (dialog.dataset.slRsReady) return;
      dialog.dataset.slRsReady = '1';

      var outer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (dialog.open) {
          attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
        } else {
          // Abort all session listeners at once. Panel lives in .dialog-frame.
          if (sessionAbort) { sessionAbort.abort(); sessionAbort = null; }
          var frame = dialog.querySelector('.dialog-frame');
          var panel = frame && frame.querySelector('.sl-rs');
          if (panel) panel.remove();
        }
      });

      outer.observe(dialog, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['open'] });

      if (dialog.open) attachToDialog(searchDiv, dialog);
    }

    document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', init);
    init();
  })();
The reCAPTCHA module is implemented as a standalone SDK package. It enables reCAPTCHA protection, which is natively supported by Adobe Commerce. It also provides an API allowing merchants to integrate reCAPTCHA protection into custom implementations. The current version of the module supports only reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible.
